name: 2SB772
description: PNP medium-power transistor (-3A) in TO-126 (ST calls it SOT-32), the standard complement to the NPN 2SD882 and pin-compatible with it. Collector is the center pin and the mounting tab. Marked 'B772'. Values are magnitudes; PNP rails are negative.

pins.name: B
pins.description: base (rightmost lead in front view; ST numbers it pin 1)

pins.name: C
pins.description: collector (center, tied to the metal mounting tab)

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead in front view; ST numbers it pin 3)

TO-126.notes: TO-126 (rendered with the TO-220 template). Printed face toward you, leads down: E-C-B left to right, collector in the CENTER tied to the tab. ST numbers the leads from the base end (pin 1 = B, pin 2 = C, pin 3 = E), so the datasheet pin numbers run right-to-left relative to this front view. Physically identical to the 2SD882 complement (both E-C-B).

typical_application: Voltage regulation, relay/solenoid driver, ~3W audio output (PNP half with 2SD882), DC-DC converters and general medium-power switching; mount the tab to a heatsink near its rating.
gotchas: TO-126 (not TO-92); collector is the CENTER pin and the mounting tab, at collector potential, so isolate from a grounded heatsink
ST numbers the leads pin1=B, pin2=C, pin3=E, which runs opposite to the front-view left-to-right order (E-C-B); identify the collector by the tab, not the printed number
ST names the package SOT-32, which is the same body as TO-126, not a small SMD package
